text:
maria: Heads up — since the canary rollout of 4756 we’re seeing a sawtooth latency pattern on CTB hosts, token/sec drops ~30% for 2-3min every ~7min.
kevin: ugh, saw that on dashboards too. queue depth spikes then drains slowly. Any obvious kernel fallback traces?
ryan: profiling shows long tail in scheduler wake path, and a KV cache miss burst aligned with the spikes. attaching quick flame: 
```
ctb.scheduler.wait_for_batch -> prefetch_check -> kv_cache.lookup (hot miss) -> memcopy -> kernel_select
``` 
maria: the KV miss rate went from 2% to ~18% during spikes. that correlates with token/sec drop.
kevin: does this match the prefetch threshold change from PR #4756? that touched prefetch window + aging heuristics.
ryan: did a light bisect locally. short list: commit d3e4f9a (prefetch: reduce lookahead from 64->32) reproduces the sawtooth on my perf rig.
maria: nice triage. so reducing lookahead reduces steady-state batching effectiveness and causes periodic underfill -> queue pressure -> kv warming thrash?
kevin: yep. CTB expected to absorb variance; smaller lookahead oscillates with request bursts. also KV cache staleness makes the next batches heavier.
observability-bot: anomaly detected: ctb.token_per_sec down 28% (hosts: ctb-prod-5..ctb-prod-12). correlated metric: kv_cache.miss_rate up 16pp. (alert id: A-2026-CTB-8421)
ryan: repro command I used: 
```
/tools/perf_sim --profile ctb --rps 450 --seqlen-dist=short_bursty --commit=d3e4f9a
```
kevin: any quick mitigation we can roll to stop rollout? revert or tweak prefetch param upward?
maria: we already paused the rollout, but some clusters hit the canary earlier. recommend hotfix: set lookahead=64 via runtime override and hold rollout.
kevin: +1. can we set a feature flag until we ship a better heuristic? I can push a runtime config change.
ryan: also adding a guard to KV prefetch so we don’t evict useful entries during transient waves. will open a follow-up PR.
maria: action items: (1) @kevin push runtime override to set lookahead=64 immediately, (2) @ryan open PR with KV prefetch guard and a unit perf test, (3) observability add synthetic that simulates sawtooth pattern and alerts at 15% token/sec degradation.
kevin: doing override now. will post deploy id.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-override/set-lookahead-64 (deploy id: dpl-8921) to ctb-canary group
maria: thanks. once override is live, monitor kv miss and token/sec for 2 windows and then consider moving canary forward.
observability-bot: deploy dpl-8921 succeeded on ctb-canary in 75s. metric watchrule active.
ryan: opened PR #4799 with KV prefetch guard + test, description and perf numbers included.
kevin: rollback/revert note: if override doesn’t stabilize, we should revert PR 4756. tagging it in the incident timeline.
maria: agreed. keeping this thread for updates. short posts only please. :thumbsup:
